title: blue modern business pitch deck
source: Blue Modern Business Pitch Deck Presentation.pptx
overall_deck_description: This 10-slide modern business pitch deck follows a cohesive, dark-mode corporate design anchored by a deep black and glowing electric-blue radial gradient background. The presentation is structured with a high-impact title cover (slide 0), sequential multi-column body slides featuring numbered points, lists, and inset photography (slides 1–8), and a symmetrical closing slide mirroring the title layout (slide 9). Recurring design motifs establish unity throughout, including a rounded pill badge in the upper-left corner for company branding, persistent metadata anchors (website URL, year stamp, and presenter credentials) along the outer perimeter, and ultra-bold geometric sans-serif display typography paired with clean, crisp white body text and circular outlined step indicators.
